title: CLCON/5/2013 of SWAMI SURESHANAND Vs MAHANT SRI KRISHNA GIRI and OTHERS

paras.text:
CLCON No. 05 of 2013
Hon'ble Alok Singh, J.
None is present for the contempt applicant.
Mr. Siddharth Jain, Advocate for the OP
No. 1.
It seems that contempt applicant is not
interested in pursuing the contempt application.
Contempt application stands dismissed for
non-prosecution. Therefore, contempt notice
issued earlier stands discharged.
(Alok Singh, J.)
 16.07.2015
Deepak
